buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && for f in coming-soon:index contact:contact; do sed "s|__WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY__|${WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY}|" "${f%%:*}.html" > "dist/${f##*:}.html"; done && cp about.html privacy.html terms.html page.css symptom.css anuva-logo-mark.png anuva-logo-icon.png anu-mascot.png dist/ && mkdir -p dist/symptoms && cp symptoms/*.html dist/symptoms/
